name: pantsonly
description: PantsOnly blocks YouTube Shorts in Firefox, Zen, Chrome, and other Chromium browsers.

scripts.build: npm run generate && node scripts/build.mjs firefox && node scripts/build.mjs chrome
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check background.js && node --check rules.js && node --check content.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/capture-store-screenshots.mjs && node --check test/live-youtube.mjs && npm test && node test/validate.mjs && npm run lint:addon
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.smoke:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir build/firefox --target firefox-desktop --start-url 'https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=iphone+duo'
scripts.smoke:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir build/chrome --target chromium --start-url 'https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=iphone+duo'
